questions.question: In a Microsoft Azure region with 3 Availability Zones, a service achieves 99.9% uptime per zone. If requests fail only when all 3 zones are down simultaneously, what is the theoretical overall cluster availability?
questions.explanation: Probability of a single zone failing = 1 - 0.999 = 0.001 = 10^-3. Probability all 3 fail simultaneously = (10^-3)^3 = 10^-9. Availability = 1 - 10^-9 = 99.9999999%.

questions.question: A Microsoft Codility problem requires checking if an integer N is a power of 4 using bitwise operators. Which expression evaluates to true if and only if N > 0 is a power of 4?
questions.explanation: A power of 4 must be a power of 2: (N & (N - 1)) == 0, and its single 1-bit must be in an odd position: 0x55555555 = binary 01010101...mask.

questions.question: Azure Cosmos DB charges Request Units (RUs). A 1KB point read costs 1 RU. A point write costs 5 RUs. If a microservice executes 1,200 reads and 400 writes per second, how many total RUs/sec are consumed?
questions.explanation: Reads: 1,200 * 1 RU = 1,200 RUs. Writes: 400 * 5 RUs = 2,000 RUs. Total = 1,200 + 2,000 = 3,200 RUs/sec.

questions.question: How many distinct binary search trees can be formed with 4 distinct keys {1, 2, 3, 4}?
questions.explanation: The number of distinct BSTs with n keys is the nth Catalan number C_n = (2n)! / ((n+1)! * n!). For n=4: C_4 = 8! / (5! * 4!) = 40320 / (120 * 24) = 14.

questions.question: In Windows NTFS file system, cluster size is 4KB (4,096 bytes). If 10 files of size 4,500 bytes each are stored, what is the total disk space allocated?
questions.explanation: Each 4,500-byte file exceeds 1 cluster (4KB) and requires 2 clusters (8KB). 10 files * 8KB = 80 KB allocated.

questions.question: A C# microservice thread pool has 16 worker threads. Requests arrive at a Poisson rate of 200 req/sec and each takes an average of 50ms to execute. What is the average CPU thread utilization?
questions.explanation: Workload = 200 req/s * 0.050 s = 10 thread-seconds of work per second. Across 16 threads, utilization = 10 / 16 = 0.625 = 62.5%.

questions.question: An array contains numbers from 1 to N with exactly one duplicate and one missing number. If the array size is 10, sum is 52, and sum of squares is 382, what is the missing number?
questions.explanation: Sum 1..10 = 55. Sum of squares = 10*11*21/6 = 385. Diff = (Dup - Miss) = 52 - 55 = -3. (Dup^2 - Miss^2) = 382 - 385 = -3. (Dup + Miss) = -3 / -3 = 1. Solving gives Missing = 2 or 6.

questions.question: In a Microsoft Teams call, bandwidth is 1.5 Mbps for HD video. If audio takes 64 Kbps and telemetry takes 16 Kbps, what percentage of the total stream is dedicated to video?
questions.explanation: Total = 1500 + 64 + 16 = 1580 Kbps. Video percentage = 1500 / 1580 ≈ 94.94%.

questions.question: An Azure Blob storage container has 8 Million objects. A batch scanning algorithm inspects 50,000 objects every 30 seconds. How many total hours will it take to scan all objects?
questions.explanation: Rate = 50,000 / 30s = 1,666.67 objects/sec = 100,000 objects/min = 6,000,000 objects/hr. Time = 8,000,000 / 6,000,000 = 1.33 hours (80 minutes).

questions.question: Given an N x N matrix, in how many ways can an algorithm traverse from top-left (0,0) to bottom-right (N-1, N-1) moving only Right and Down?
questions.explanation: The path consists of N-1 Down moves and N-1 Right moves, total 2N-2 moves. Number of distinct paths is C(2N-2, N-1).

questions.question: In an Azure DevOps pipeline, build stage succeeds with probability 0.95 and test stage succeeds with probability 0.90 given build succeeded. What is the probability that both build and test pass?
questions.explanation: P(Build and Test) = P(Build) * P(Test | Build) = 0.95 * 0.90 = 0.855 = 85.5%.

questions.question: A 32-bit unsigned integer bitmask has bits 2, 5, and 7 set to 1 (0-indexed). What is its decimal integer value?
If an Azure Virtual Machine uses 128-bit encryption keys, how many possible distinct keys can be generated?
questions.explanation: Each bit can be 0 or 1. For 128 bits, total permutations = 2^128 (approx 3.4 * 10^38 keys).

questions.question: A memory leak in a C# service consumes 25 MB every 10 minutes. If the container memory limit is 2 GB and starts with 500 MB baseline, in how many hours will OOM (Out Of Memory) occur?
questions.explanation: Remaining memory until limit = 2048 - 500 = 1548 MB. Leak rate = 2.5 MB/min = 150 MB/hour. Time = 1500 / 150 = 10.0 hours.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height H=5 (where root has height 1)?
questions.explanation: Maximum nodes in binary tree of height H is 2^H - 1. For H=5: 2^5 - 1 = 32 - 1 = 31 nodes.

questions.question: Given the head of a linked list, reverse the nodes of the list k at a time, and return the modified list. If the number of nodes is not a multiple of k left out at the end, should remain as is.
questions.explanation: Classic Microsoft pointer manipulation: Count k nodes ahead; reverse the group iteratively; connect with recursive tail.

extra.title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group (Linked List)

questions.question: Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order.
questions.explanation: Four boundary pointers (top, bottom, left, right) progressively shrinking inward after each boundary traversal.

extra.title: Spiral Matrix Order Traversal

questions.question: Given the root of a binary tree, return the zigzag level order traversal of its nodes' values (from left to right, then right to left for the next level).
questions.explanation: BFS using a Deque or List with a boolean direction flag inverted on each tree depth level.

extra.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal

questions.question: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s.
questions.explanation: Expand around centers: Check 2N-1 possible centers for odd and even length palindromes in O(N^2) time and O(1) space.

extra.title: Longest Palindromic Substring

questions.question: Given the array nums after the possible rotation and an integer target, return the index of target if it is in nums, or -1 if it is not in nums in O(log N) runtime.
questions.explanation: Modified binary search: Determine which half of the array is sorted (left or right), then check if target lies within that sorted range.

extra.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array

questions.question: There is a function signFunc(x) that returns 1 if x is positive, -1 if x is negative, and 0 if x is equal to 0. You are given an integer array nums. Return signFunc(product of nums).
questions.explanation: Count negative numbers without computing large product to prevent integer overflow. Return 0 if any element is 0.

extra.title: Sign of the Product of an Array

questions.question: Implement the myAtoi(string s) function, which converts a string to a 32-bit signed integer with whitespace handling, signs, and 32-bit clamping.
questions.explanation: Parse leading whitespace, parse optional sign, accumulate digits checking for 32-bit overflow before multiplication.

extra.title: String to Integer (atoi) Parser

questions.question: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST).
questions.explanation: Recursive range validation: Every node must satisfy min < node.val < max, or in-order traversal must be strictly increasing.

extra.title: Validate Binary Search Tree (BST)

questions.question: Explain the architecture of Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID), specifically OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE for single-page and native apps.
questions.explanation: PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) protects authorization codes from interception by generating a cryptographically random code_verifier and code_challenge, validated by Entra ID token endpoint without client secrets.

questions.question: Compare the .NET Core / CLR Garbage Collector generations (Gen 0, Gen 1, Gen 2, Large Object Heap) with the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) generational memory model.
questions.explanation: Both use generational hypothesis: Gen 0 holds short-lived objects; survivors promote to Gen 1 and Gen 2. .NET has dedicated LOH (>85KB) collected with Gen 2. JVM uses Eden, Survivor spaces, and Tenured generation.

extra.company_focus: Growth mindset, Azure cloud infrastructure, .NET CLR and modern Java, Cosmos DB consistency, clean modular code

questions.question: How does Azure Cosmos DB offer 5 tunable consistency levels (Strong, Bounded Staleness, Session, Consistent Prefix, Eventual), and what are the latency/cost tradeoffs?
questions.explanation: Session consistency (default) ensures read-your-own-writes per client session with single RU cost. Strong consistency guarantees linearizability across regions at 2x RU cost and higher write latency.

questions.question: Explain how C# async/await state machines operate under the hood in .NET. How does this compare with Java Virtual Threads (Project Loom)?
questions.explanation: C# compiler transforms async methods into a generated struct implementing IAsyncStateMachine, suspending state via TaskAwaiter without blocking OS threads. Java Virtual Threads decouple threads at the JVM scheduler level without rewriting methods to state machines.

questions.explanation: Azure Container Apps provides serverless microservices built on Kubernetes and Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) with KEDA autoscaling to zero. App Service is suited for monolithic web apps.

questions.question: How do you implement Hybrid Search in Azure AI Search combining BM25 keyword matching with dense vector embeddings and semantic re-ranking?
questions.explanation: Explain: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) algorithm merging BM25 and vector score ranks, followed by Microsoft Turing semantic re-ranker evaluating deep cross-attention.

questions.question: How do you evaluate and monitor LLM performance in production using Azure AI Studio evaluation SDK (groundedness, relevance, coherence)?

questions.question: How would you build a multi-modal document extraction pipeline using Azure AI Document Intelligence (Form Recognizer) for complex invoice PDFs?

questions.question: Describe how you implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over sensitive enterprise SharePoint documents while strictly respecting user permission ACLs.

questions.question: Azure Cosmos DB charges Request Units (RUs). A 1KB point read costs 1 RU. A point write costs 5 RUs. If a microservice executes 1,200 reads and 400 writes per second, how many total RUs/sec are consumed? [MICROSOFT Version]

questions.question: How many distinct binary search trees can be formed with 4 distinct keys {1, 2, 3, 4}? [MICROSOFT Version]

questions.question: In Windows NTFS file system, cluster size is 4KB (4,096 bytes). If 10 files of size 4,500 bytes each are stored, what is the total disk space allocated? [MICROSOFT Version]
questions.explanation: Each 4,500-byte file exceeds 1 cluster (4KB) and requires 2 clusters (8KB). 10 files * 8KB = 80 KB allocated.

questions.question: A C# microservice thread pool has 16 worker threads. Requests arrive at a Poisson rate of 200 req/sec and each takes an average of 50ms to execute. What is the average CPU thread utilization? [MICROSOFT Version]

questions.question: An array contains numbers from 1 to N with exactly one duplicate and one missing number. If the array size is 10, sum is 52, and sum of squares is 382, what is the missing number? [MICROSOFT Version]
questions.explanation: Sum 1..10 = 55. Sum of squares = 10*11*21/6 = 385. Diff = (Dup - Miss) = 52 - 55 = -3. (Dup^2 - Miss^2) = 382 - 385 = -3. (Dup + Miss) = -3 / -3 = 1. Solving gives Missing = 2 or 6.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had a technical disagreement with a colleague. How did you resolve it constructively without damaging the relationship? [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Explain: Focusing on objective data and user impact rather than personality, active listening, and finding consensus.

questions.question: Why do you specifically want to build your software engineering career at Microsoft? [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Connect: Microsoft's mission 'to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more', enterprise cloud dominance, developer-first tooling (VS Code, GitHub).

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to balance urgent product release deadlines with code maintainability and test automation. [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Show: Pragmatic technical debt management, automated regression guardrails, and post-launch refactoring commitments.

questions.question: How do you keep your technical skills sharp in an era of rapid AI transformation and evolving cloud frameworks? [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Highlight: Proactive side projects, studying architecture papers, continuous experimentation, and mentoring others.

questions.question: Describe a time you received critical feedback on your performance or code quality. How did you process and act on that feedback? [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Demonstrate: Emotional maturity, seeking specific examples for improvement, and demonstrating measurable growth in subsequent sprints.

questions.question: Do you have any questions for Microsoft's engineering leadership regarding team culture, engineering velocity, or our cloud roadmap? [MICROSOFT Culture Dimension]
questions.explanation: Candidate asks thoughtful questions about Microsoft's AI integration across products, developer developer developer ethos, or career progression.
